title: Frukt Cyder Blueberry & Lime 100ml E-liquid
description: Blueberry & Lime from Frukt Cyder is a deliciously sweet and refreshing fusion of rich, sweet blueberries given a zesty, sour edge from fresh limes. The combination produces an endlessly satisfying vape that sings with summer, and the light, bubbly effervescence of English Cider. This convenient 100ml nicotine-free shortfill bottle comes with 20ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered sub-ohm tanks and mods
